sources.title: 令和5年度 市町村税課税状況等の調 第11表〔市町村別内訳〕課税標準額段階別所得割額等に関する調（合計）
sources.note: The municipal breakdown carries totals only; the 課税標準額段階別 bracket counts exist at the national/prefecture level (第5表〜第11表 総括表), not by municipality.

notes: 課税対象所得 / 課税標準額 are income after deductions of all taxpayers (including pension and property income earners); they are not the ESS 主な仕事からの年間収入 of workers, so only within-prefecture relative levels are compared.
Designated-city wards are not separate municipalities in this survey; the model's ward arrays are aggregated to the city. Tokyo's 23 特別区 are separate entries.
